meta.title: Wedding DJ in Malaga | Oliver Party Expert
meta.description: Wedding DJ, lighting, food trucks, crepes, ice cream trolley, photobooth and neon décor in Velez-Malaga, Malaga and the Costa del Sol.

hero.title: Wedding DJ and party experiences in Malaga
hero.lead: Music, lighting, food trucks, crepes, ice cream and a photobooth so your celebration is remembered. Spanish and English, for local and destination couples.

services.title: Everything for your wedding, from one team
services.lead: DJ, lighting, food trucks and décor with transport and set-up. Download the dossier for each service.

dj.title: DJ and sound
dj.text: Ceremony, drinks reception, dinner and party. 15+ years at venues such as Parque del Río, Cortijo Bravo and Hotel La Viñuela. Open playlist: pop, Latin, disco, flamenco and requests.

lighting.title: Lighting and effects
lighting.text: Light show, haze and cold sparklers for the first dance and a dancefloor that photographs beautifully.

food-trucks.title: Food trucks
food-trucks.text: Food trucks and horse truck to surprise guests at the cocktail hour or late-night snack. Set-up included.

crepes.title: Crepe station
crepes.text: A sweet crepe station for guests of every age. A crowd-pleaser every time.

ice-cream.title: Ice cream trolley
ice-cream.text: Artisan ice cream, 50+ flavours and a tricycle trolley for the garden or cocktail hour.

photobooth.title: Photobooth
photobooth.text: Photobooth with props, neon and a guest book album. Digital copies for the couple.

neons.title: Neons and LOVE letters
neons.text: Heart neon, LOVE letters, photocalls and initials. Décor made for photos.

furniture.title: Lounge furniture
furniture.text: Sofas, armchairs, desks, lit bars and chill-out corners.

popcorn.title: Popcorn and candy floss
popcorn.text: Popcorn and candy-floss machines: a hit with children and adults.

beer-tricycle.title: Beer tricycle
beer-tricycle.text: Vintage beer cart and tricycle for the free bar.

gallery.title: Parties that stay with you
gallery.lead: Real event photos from Oliver Party Expert. Videos stay on social media for now; YouTube can be added later.

about.title: Oliver Party Expert
about.lead: A host DJ with 20+ years on the decks, from the 80s and 90s to today. Fairs, clubs, and a team that treats you like family.
about.p1: Modern lighting, games, choreography and surprises so your day does not look like anyone else’s wedding.
about.p2: Based in Velez-Malaga, we travel across Malaga, Marbella, Granada, Almeria, Cadiz and Seville.

location.title: Velez-Malaga, in the Axarquia
location.lead: Del Río 36 B, 29700 Velez-Malaga. Serving the Costa del Sol and Andalusia.

when.q: How far in advance should we book?
when.a: We recommend three months for DJ and sound, and 6–8 months for décor and food-truck packages in peak season.

travel.a: Yes — Malaga, Costa del Sol, Marbella, Granada, Almeria, Cadiz and Seville. Mileage may be charged.

languages.a: Yes. We look after local and destination-wedding couples in Spanish and English.

pack.q: What is in a wedding pack?
pack.a: Full sound for ceremony, cocktail, dinner and free bar, plus lighting and haze. Other extras are mixed to taste.
